svg.font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Traffic tactics ordered by how long they take and what they are worth
svg.desc: Three bands. In days: internal linking and a sharper title, an afternoon and no money. In weeks to months: consolidating pages that compete and covering a subject properly. Slowest and highest value: publishing something only your business could have written, which Google names as the strongest lever and which a competitor cannot copy in an afternoon.
svg.text: Internal linking, and a sharper title
An afternoon and no money, and it can show up within a crawl cycle.
Consolidating pages that compete; covering a subject
A new page competing for anything worth having takes weeks to months.
Publishing what only your business could write
Google names it the strongest lever it has, and the only item
that a competitor cannot copy from you in an afternoon.
List the ten pages nothing links to, and link them from the pages that already get read.
